releaseNotes:
e-PolyPariksha HP update v1.0.3 (Build 87):
- Added real-time Security Alert Notification Bell in middle top of Admin dashboard with breach counter badge.
- Instant logging & auto-lock when a student unpins the exam app.
- Detailed security logs displaying student name, branch, semester, class roll no, board roll no, and exact security violation.
- Strict split-screen pre-check prevents starting tests in split-screen mode and fixes 'Attempt not found' submission errors.
